# Interface text (labels)

The kits' fixed words (buttons, counts, messages, screen-reader text) can be given in the document's language. Set `lang` and, in `labels`, the text to use for any of these English keys; the rest stay English. `{name}` marks a value filled in (keep it in your text). A count's key takes its plural forms, `{ one: …, other: … }` (and `zero`, `two`, `few`, `many` where the language has them, as `Intl.PluralRules` names them); a single text is used for every count.

```yaml
version: 1
lang: es
labels:
  "Rows per page": "Filas por página"
  "Page {page} of {pages}": "Página {page} de {pages}"
  "{n} results": { one: "{n} resultado", other: "{n} resultados" }
root: …
```
